title: UIAO OrgPath Codebook — Model C (15-Facet Multi-Attribute)
description: Machine-readable per-facet enumeration of canonical OrgPath values. Per ADR-078, each of the 15 onPremisesExtensionAttribute slots carries one semantic facet (Region, Department, Division, Role, CostCenter, Classification, HireDate, TermDate, ClearanceLevel, AccountType; slots 11-14 reserved for tenant-specific extension). Per ADR-127 (Hybrid-C+Path), slot 15 carries the derived canonical OrgPath — the inheritance layer composed from the governance-layer hierarchy facets with a trailing delimiter always present. Every value appearing in a slot must resolve to an entry in that facet's enumeration (for enumerated facets) or match its value_pattern (for typed facets) or it is classified as DRIFT-SEMANTIC. Supersedes the v1 composite-hyphen schema per ADR-078; UIAO has no production adopters at ratification time, so the prior Model A schema is not preserved as a legacy file.

schema_version.description: Major version pinned to 2 — Model C. Future Model C minor/patch updates increment the second/third digit.

model.description: Identifies this codebook as Model C (15-facet multi-attribute) per ADR-078. Model A (composite-hyphen) is superseded and not represented in this schema version.

adoption_tier_min.description: Minimum ADR-076 conformance tier at which this codebook is operationally adopted. Per ADR-078, Model C is Tier 3+ doctrine.

hybrid.description: Hybrid-C+Path model declaration (ADR-127). Two layers over the 15 slots: the Model C facet decomposition on extensionAttribute1-14 (governance layer) and a derived canonical OrgPath string on extensionAttribute15 (inheritance layer). The derived path is composed from the governance-layer hierarchy facets with every segment — including the last — terminated by the delimiter, so -startsWith / like prefix matching is unambiguous.

facet.description: Name of the facet (declared under `facets`) that carries the derived path.

derived_from.description: Ordered facet names composed into the derived path. Integrity (each names a declared, projected facet) is enforced by the loader.

segment_labels.description: Optional per-facet segment label overrides (facet name → path segment label).

trailing_delimiter.description: Every segment, including the last, is terminated by the delimiter — the fix that makes prefix matching collision-free, since a terminated prefix cannot match a longer sibling value.

facets.description: Per-facet declarations keyed by facet name (snake_case). Each facet binds to exactly one onPremisesExtensionAttribute slot. The 10 canonical facets (region, department, division, role, cost_center, classification, hire_date, term_date, clearance_level, account_type) map to attributes 1-10 per ADR-078. Slots 11-15 are reserved and declared as kind: reserved unless a governed PR has promoted them to tenant-specific facets.

deprecated.description: Per-facet deprecated values. Keys are facet names; values are arrays of deprecated entries with replaced_by pointing at an active value in the same facet's enumeration.

attribute.description: onPremisesExtensionAttribute slot (extensionAttribute1 through extensionAttribute15) this facet binds to. Slot uniqueness is enforced at integrity-check time by the loader, not in JSON Schema.

kind.description: enumerated = closed list of valid values; typed = open set constrained by value_type and optional value_pattern (e.g., ISO dates); reserved = no semantics declared (slots 11-15 by default).

enumeration.description: Required when kind == enumerated. List of valid values.

value_type.description: Required when kind == typed. Coarse type hint for downstream consumers.

value_pattern.description: Optional regex constraint when kind == typed. The drift engine rejects values not matching this pattern.

allow_empty.description: Whether an empty string is a valid value. On a typed facet this covers cases like TermDate for active employees. On an enumerated facet it marks the facet as optional (ADR-137): an unpopulated slot is a legitimate state rather than drift, while any non-empty value is still validated against the enumeration.

projected.description: Whether this facet is stamped onto a directory extensionAttribute slot (ADR-121). false keeps the facet's semantics (HR-SSOT / reporting / JML lifecycle) without consuming a scarce slot; only projected facets are written per object.
